headlines.description: Pacifica Pier, battered by powerful storms and showing signs of serious wear, is receiving more than $2 million in new state funding to help protect it. State and local leaders announced the funding Friday morning. Despite high surf during recent storms, crews have been working on repairs after major concrete cracks were discovered in early June. The new funding will go toward stabilization efforts, preserving coastal access and strengthening the pier. Pacifica Nov 8 Pacifica Oct 22 Pacifica Jun 23 Future of Pacifica Pier back on agenda as county weighs emergency extension
headlines.source: Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga | The Associated Press
